headline: Keep permit evidence and renewal risk visible without bypassing authority
capabilities: Predict failures with real-time analysis and automated planning
Automate permit tracking and renewals with intelligent workflows
Generate audit-ready reports quickly with streamlined data collection
Consolidate fragmented data into real-time insights for easy centralized monitoring
outcomes: Improved asset reliability, reducing unplanned downtime and costs
Maintained compliance and operational continuity across facilities
Streamlined compliance reporting and minimized audit risk
Gained real-time visibility and strategic planning support to achieve emissions goals
why_try: Compliance and facility teams can ask which permit needs attention and receive the exact record, deadline, authority, and human review boundary.

sample_prompts.label: Facility Manager: Permit status and expiring permits
sample_prompts.prompt: Show me our permit status and any expiring soon

sample_prompts.label: Permit Coordinator: Renewal deadlines and lead times
sample_prompts.prompt: Which permit renewals have already missed their lead time, and how many days are left?

sample_prompts.label: Compliance Manager: Compliance gap triage
sample_prompts.prompt: What permit evidence gap needs immediate authorized review?

sample_prompts.label: Environmental Counsel: Application tracking
sample_prompts.prompt: Where does the Imperial Valley Solar Phase 2 application stand, and did we submit anything today?

sample_prompts.label: Operations Director: Emergency renewal package
sample_prompts.prompt: Start emergency renewals for the critical permits.

business_flow: Compliance managers, permit coordinators, facility managers, and environmental counsel
Authorized permit owner and legal reviewer
